newsitem.title: BELARUS: SOCCER-LATE DOUBLE HANDS BELSHYNA BELARUSSIAN CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LATE DOUBLE HANDS BELSHYNA BELARUSSIAN CUP.

text.p: Two goals in the last eight minutes secured the Belarussian Cup for Belshyna Bobruisk over Dinamo-93 Minsk on Sunday.

Belshyna have risen from obscurity in Soviet times to become a considerable force in Belarussian soccer thanks to generous sponsorship from Bobruisk's giant chemical plant. Cup winners in 1995, they currently lead the league.

Five thousand spectators were treated to a lacklustre final until the 82nd minute when a Vasily Smirnykh header converted a cross into a 1-0 lead. Dmitry Balashov made sure four minutes later, beating three Dynamo 93 defenders before burying a powerful shot.
The omens had always been in Belshyna's favour -- Belarus was celebrating Chemical Workers Day on Sunday.
